QF.id: I Clearing Settlement and Risk Management_58

question.text: What is the position limit for a domestic client (non-institutional individual client) in USDINR contracts?

answer.text: Higher of 6% of the total open interest or USD 20 million
Higher of 15% of the total open interest or USD 100 million
Higher of 6% of the total open interest or USD 10 million
Higher of 15% of the total open interest or USD 50 million

explanation.text: The Logic: Page 162 lists the position limit for Domestic Clients, NRIs and FPI Cat II (Individuals, family offices and corporates) in USDINR as the higher of 6% of total open interest or USD 20 million. The Trap: USD 10 million is the equivalent client limit for EURINR, GBPINR and USDJPY; do not apply it to USDINR. Note: The 6% threshold applies to clients, while the 15% threshold applies at the trading-member level — keep the two percentages separated.
